title: No deployment above a measurable bio-uplift threshold
statement: The organisation will not externally deploy a model whose evaluated uplift on the named benchmark exceeds the stated threshold.

trigger.statement: Evaluated uplift exceeds the published threshold on the named benchmark.
trigger.measurement_window: most recent eval, within 60 days of release decision

enforcer.escalation: A failed gate halts deployment and is reported to the board within 10 business days.

dependencies.statement: The named benchmark continues to be a valid proxy for uplift; if it is retired, the gate is reviewed within 90 days.
The internal red-team retains the budget to run the eval ahead of each deploy.
